About us
Graphcore is one of the worlds leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.
It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.
As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the worlds most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.
Graphcores teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.


Job Summary
Reporting to senior leadership within Architecture and Validation, the Power and Performance Validation Lead will drive validation strategy and execution for advanced AI compute silicon and systems. The role is responsible for leading power, thermal and performance validation activities across pre-silicon and post-silicon environments to ensure products meet efficiency, reliability and scalability expectations.
This role requires strong technical expertise and collaboration across multiple engineering disciplines to deliver robust validation methodologies, scalable automation frameworks and actionable performance insights.


The Team
The Power and Performance Validation team sits within the Architecture and Validation organisation and is responsible for validating the performance, efficiency and thermal behaviour of Graphcore silicon and systems.
The team supports the full product lifecycle, from early architectural modelling through to first silicon bring-up, characterization and production readiness. Engineers work closely with cross-functional teams globally to debug complex issues, optimize workloads and continuously improve validation infrastructure and methodologies.


Responsibilities and Duties
  • Define and lead validation strategies for power, thermal and performance characterization of AI compute silicon and platforms
  • Contribute to planning and execution of validation activities across multiple projects and milestones
  • Develop comprehensive validation plans covering functional, stress, workload and corner-case scenarios
  • Lead post-silicon bring-up and characterization activities for power and performance validation
  • Drive validation of CPU, memory, interconnect and high-speed I/O subsystems under complex workload conditions
  • Develop scalable automation frameworks, regression infrastructure and reporting tools using Python
  • Design and execute benchmark workloads, parameter sweeps and performance experiments to identify optimization opportunities
  • Collaborate with architecture, RTL, firmware, software and systems teams to debug and resolve complex technical issues
  • Define validation metrics, pass/fail criteria and reporting methodologies to ensure repeatable and high-quality analysis
  • Guide development of custom workload generators and micro-benchmarks where required
  • Analyse power, thermal and performance data to identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of validation processes, tooling and engineering practices
  • Communicate technical findings, project status, risks and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and engineering leadership
  • Support knowledge sharing and contribute to continuous improvement across the validation organisation


Candidate Profile
Essential:
  • Strong experience in power and performance validation, silicon characterization or system performance engineering
  • Deep understanding of modern SoC architecture, including CPU, memory, interconnect and high-speed I/O technologies
  • Strong Linux systems knowledge and low-level performance analysis experience
  • Strong Python programming skills for automation, orchestration and data analysis
  • Experience with benchmarking and profiling tools such as stress-ng, fio, perf, iperf or equivalent technologies
  • Experience debugging complex hardware and software interactions
  • Ability to define structured validation methodologies, workload models and test strategies
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify system bottlenecks
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently on complex technical tasks while collaborating effectively across teams
Desirable
  • Experience with AI accelerator, GPU or high-performance compute architectures
  • Experience with pre-silicon modelling or simulation environments
  • Knowledge of power management technologies and silicon characterization methodologies
  • Programming experience in C/C++ for low-level system or benchmark development
  • Familiarity with hardware instrumentation and telemetry systems
  • Experience working with high core-count or large-scale compute systems
  • Experience contributing to shared validation infrastructure and engineering best practices

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary


Reporting to the Memory Validation leadership team, the DDR HBM Validation Engineer will be responsible for the bring-up, validation, characterization and debug of advanced memory subsystems used in next-generation AI compute platforms.


The role will focus on DDR and HBM technologies, working closely with silicon design, firmware, characterization, platform and systems teams to ensure robust memory subsystem functionality, performance and reliability. The successful candidate will take ownership of significant validation activities, contribute to debug and root-cause analysis efforts, and help improve validation methodologies, automation and infrastructure.


The Team


The Memory Validation team sits within the Validation organisation and is responsible for the bring-up, validation, characterization and debug of memory subsystems across Graphcore silicon and platform products.


The team supports DDR and HBM validation activities throughout the product lifecycle, from first silicon through production readiness. Engineers work closely with architecture, RTL, firmware, characterization, systems and platform teams to ensure memory technologies meet functionality, performance, reliability and performance objectives.


Responsibilities and Duties



  • Execute validation and bring-up activities for DDR and HBM memory subsystems;

  • Verify memory bring-up software, firmware and scripts against defined project requirements;

  • Debug firmware, hardware and system-level issues and contribute to root-cause analysis activities;

  • Analyse system logs, validation data and characterization results to identify failures and performance issues;

  • Perform PHY characterization and analog-level analysis during stress testing and validation activities;

  • Develop and execute functional, stress, performance and corner-case validation tests;

  • Perform signal integrity, voltage, frequency and timing measurements using laboratory instrumentation;

  • Characterize memory bandwidth, latency, training behaviour and subsystem stability across operating conditions;

  • Develop Python-based automation, test infrastructure and reporting tools to improve validation efficiency;

  • Collaborate with architecture, RTL, firmware and platform teams to investigate and resolve technical issues;

  • Contribute to memory subsystem debug activities spanning silicon, firmware, board and system domains;

  • Support development of validation methodologies, debug procedures and reporting frameworks;

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of validation infrastructure and engineering processes;

  • Support silicon characterization, production readiness and qualification activities;

  • Document validation results and communicate findings to the wider engineering team;


Candidate Profile


Essential



  • Strong experience validating DDR, LPDDR, HBM or related DRAM technologies;

  • Deep understanding of DRAM architecture, memory subsystem operation and memory controller functionality;

  • Experience with firmware, BIOS and Embedded C development;

  • Strong programming skills in C and Python;

  • Hands-on experience using laboratory equipment including oscilloscopes and related measurement instrumentation;

  • Experience interfacing with low-speed peripherals including GPIO, SPI, I2C and UART/serial interfaces;

  • Experience performing functional testing and signal measurements including voltage, frequency and timing analysis;

  • Strong knowledge of embedded systems and microcontroller-based platforms;

  • Hands-on experience with board bring-up and hardware validation activities;

  • Experience debugging complex hardware, firmware and system-level issues;

  • Experience performing silicon characterization and analysing validation results;

  • Strong analytical, diagnostic and problem-solving skills;

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams;


Desirable



  • Experience with memory IP bring-up environments, firmware or validation software;

  • Experience with DDR or HBM PHY behaviour, memory controller architectures, training algorithms and calibration flows;

  • Knowledge of memory subsystem performance analysis and workload characterization;

  • Experience with memory margining, stress testing and reliability validation;

  • Familiarity with JTAG, trace infrastructure and low-level debug tools;

  • Experience with high-performance compute, AI accelerator or data center systems;

  • Understanding of signal integrity and power integrity considerations in high-speed memory systems;

  • Experience developing validation automation frameworks and regression environments;

  • Experience supporting first-silicon bring-up and production readiness activities;

As part of Accentures Reinvention Deployed Engineering (RDE) organization within Strategy Consulting, you will work in a collocated pod that turns AI ambition into measurable business value taking solutions from problem definition to a live, scalable outcome.

You are a process-driven, industry-embedded advisor. You redesign how businesses get work done by combining AI, automation, and human expertise into smarter, more efficient processes working at the intersection of business strategy and technology. You govern end-to-end enterprise workflows, create detailed blueprints (architectural plans, system connections, and workflow designs), define where people stay in control and where AI takes over, and translate complex business processes into AI-ready, executable designs for engineering and platform teams. The work demands hands-on design judgment that goes beyond high-level recommendations turning strategy into concrete plans implementation teams can execute, with an agent-first mindset.

Roles Responsibilities

  • Owns end-to-end workflows across functions, systems, and data, reflecting how the business truly operates.
  • Identifies where AI, automation, and orchestration can augment or replace human steps and where human judgment must stay in the loop.
  • Defines workflow logic, states, handoffs, and exception paths so each design is unambiguous and ready to build.
  • Applies industry and regulatory knowledge to keep workflows compliant, realistic, and aligned to domain operating models.
  • Translates client processes into clear, structured requirements that engineers and architects can build against.
  • Supports value identification and quantification gathers baseline data and helps define KPIs and success metrics.
  • Supports business development and client workshops conducts research and prepares materials that convey the solution and its business impact.

Must-have skills

  • Deep process design and architecture expertise Business Process Strategy, Business Process Modeling (BPM / BPMN), Business Process Design, End-to-End Process Architecture, Enterprise Process Mapping, Workflow Analysis Design, Workflow Integration, Cross-Functional Process Integration, and AI-Ready / Automation-Ready Process Design.
  • Hands-on Process Transformation and Digital Transformation experience across complex enterprise environments.
  • Command of core Business Architecture techniques Operating Model Design, Value Chain Analysis, Customer Journey Mapping, and Business Capability Modelling.
  • Industry Functional Process Expertise, Domain-Specific Operating Models, and Industry Value Stream Knowledge including end-to-end workflows such as Order to Cash, Record to Report, Hire to Retire, and Source to Pay.
  • Strong native AI fluency NLP, LLMs, RAG, Machine Learning, and Human-Machine Interaction (HMI), including agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration.
  • Hands-on experience working with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) to build working prototypes, dashboards, and solutions that address real enterprise problems, with attention to token cost and performance.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and storytelling-with-data skills, combined with analytical thinking, cross-cultural competence, and the ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.

Desirable skills

  • Experience with enterprise and AI platforms such as SAP, Oracle, PEGA, Salesforce, Workday, IBM, leading AI model providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic), and the major cloud AI stacks (Microsoft Azure AI, AWS, or Google Vertex AI).
  • Industry domain depth in one or more sectors such as Banking, Insurance, Health, Utilities, Manufacturing, Retail, or Telco.
  • Familiarity with AI Data Solution Architecture and AI-enabled operating models.
  • Experience implementing workflow automation and robotic process automation (RPA) solutions using tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Microsoft Power Automate.
  • Comfort with vibe coding rapidly prototyping working software using AI coding assistants.
  • Product management experience spanning discovery, scoping, and delivery.
  • Process discovery and analysis using process-mining tools such as Celonis or Signavio to uncover inefficiencies and automation opportunities; Lean Six Sigma certification a plus.
  • Agile / Scrum / hybrid delivery with sound SDLC governance; a relevant AI or Agentic AI certification is a plus.



Qualification

Educational Qualification

MBA or Masters degree from a Tier 1 college is preferred.

About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows-including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence-we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Principal Mobile Engineer
AI-Native Cloud Platform

Team: Mobile Platform Team

Reports to: Sr. Director of R&D, Cloud Platform

Location: [Gurgaon / Hybrid]

About the role

Payoneer is investing in the next generation of its mobile application: lightweight, high-performance, and designed as a platform that lets product teams contribute features independently while the app remains coherent, fast, and stable as a whole. The host application will provide the common foundations observability, logging, navigation, identity, networking, feature flags, release tooling, automation and product teams will plug into it through a clear contribution model.

We are hiring two Principal Mobile Engineers to define and build this foundation alongside the existing mobile team. Together you will own the tech stack decision native iOS and Android, Flutter, React Native or a hybrid and you will shape the platform every product team at Payoneer ships mobile features on top of. The two-Principal structure gives us the capacity to build the platform properly, and the optionality to specialize one Principal per native platform if we go that route.

What you ll own

You will own the tech stack decision and the rationale behind it. You will run the evaluation native (Swift / Kotlin) vs Flutter vs React Native vs hybrid against real constraints: performance, binary size, hiring market, team contribution model, build and release velocity, long-term maintenance cost. You will make the call jointly with your peer Principal and you will be expected to defend it under scrutiny from engineering, product, and executive leadership.

You will build the host application foundation. The architecture, the module boundaries, the navigation and lifecycle model, the dependency injection approach, the state management patterns, the threading and concurrency model, the network stack, the persistence layer, the observability and logging backbone, the release and rollout machinery, the testing strategy at every level of the pyramid. Every product team s first impression of mobile at Payoneer will be the abstractions you ship.

You will define the contribution model that product teams use to deliver features into the host app. Module boundaries, public API surface, lifecycle hooks, dependency policy, build and integration patterns, version compatibility, and the developer experience that makes contributing a feature fast and contributing a bad one hard. You will own the standards every contributing team writes against.

You will own performance, binary size, startup time, frame rate, memory, and battery as first-class engineering disciplines with measured budgets and gates. You will own crash-free rate and stability as platform commitments. You will own the CI/CD, signing, release, and rollout pipeline for the app, and the observability that makes a production issue debuggable in minutes rather than days.

You will partner with the Application Foundations Crew and the Cloud Platform Base, DevEx, and Network and Security teams to make sure mobile integrates cleanly with the platform APIs, events, identity, secrets, automation and the shift-left controls that apply on the mobile side as much as the server side. You will partner with product engineering across the company to bring contributing teams into the platform and keep them productive in it.

What we re looking for

You have ten or more years of mobile engineering experience and you have built mobile applications from the ground up not joined them, not iterated on them, but defined the foundation and shipped it to production at scale. You have an honest, scarred view of what mobile platform decisions cost three years after you make them.

You are deeply expert in at least one of iOS or Android, and seriously fluent in the other. On iOS that means Swift, the Swift concurrency model, UIKit and SwiftUI, the Apple toolchain and release process, and the parts of the ecosystem most engineers learn the hard way. On Android that means Kotlin, coroutines and Flow, the Android lifecycle, Jetpack and Compose, Gradle in earnest, RxJava where it still lives, and the same hard-won understanding of the ecosystem.

You understand the cross-platform landscape with the same honesty. You have an opinion on Flutter, KMP, and React Native that goes beyond preference performance characteristics, ceiling, where each shines, where each fails and you can defend the recommendation you would make for a fintech app at Payoneer s scale.

You have built and operated a modular mobile platform before, or something close enough that you understand the trade-offs: how to define module boundaries that survive ten product teams contributing in parallel, how to keep the host app coherent when contributors disagree, how to version a contribution model without breaking everyone, and how to keep the binary lean as the surface grows.

You think in budgets and measurements. You have driven startup time, frame rate, binary size, and crash-free rate as numbers on a dashboard. You understand mobile observability at a level beyond crash reporting, and you have shipped the instrumentation needed to debug productio.

You communicate clearly with engineers, product partners, and executives. You can write a one-page architecture proposal, run an RFC that actually converges, demo what you built so other engineers want to use it, and explain a stack decision to a CPO in language they care about. You handle disagreement well including with your peer Principal and you know how to land a joint decision.

Nice to have

Experience integrating AI capabilities into mobile applications on-device models, conversational and agent UI patterns, latency-sensitive AI features, and the privacy and offline considerations that come with them is a strong plus, given Payoneer s AI-native platform direction.

Why this role matters

The mobile app is the surface Payoneer customers touch after Web. The foundation you build will compound for years. You will have unusual scope to define what good looks like for Payoneer, and credibly for the industry, at the point where regulated payments, mobile engineering at scale, and AI-native development converge.

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build each other up
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

The Role

You are the Shared Data discipline Solution Architect responsible for defining and governing the end-to-end approach to migrating SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and Teams-connected file content during a global tenant-to-tenant M365 consolidation.

This role exists because shared data migrations fail when they re treated like a tool run. You will define the information architecture-aware migration blueprint: permissions fidelity, sharing behaviour, metadata, large content, throttling, delta strategy, validation, exception handling and stabilisation. You will ensure the factory can execute with repeatable patterns using third-party tooling (e.g., ShareGate or equivalent) and that wave migrations don t collapse into rework.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define target-state information architecture and governance considerations relevant to tenant consolidation (sharing posture, permissions model, external sharing constraints, retention sensitivity, content ownership patterns).
  • Define the tenant-to-tenant ODSP migration strategy including discovery, mapping, staging, delta moves, cutover approach and post-move validation.
  • Standardise tooling approach (e.g., ShareGate / Quest / equivalent): configuration baselines, scheduling patterns, throttling management, reporting outputs and error handling.
  • Define runbooks for key migration tasks: site migrations, OneDrive migrations, Teams files migrations, permissions reconciliation, link/sharing remediation, metadata validation.
  • Set and enforce quality gates: ready to migrate , ready to cutover , accepted criteria including evidence packs and sampling methodologies.
  • Create the exception framework for difficult content (very large libraries, broken inheritance sprawl, customisations, third-party integrations, legacy workflows, blocked file types).
  • Define a repeatable approach to permissions and sharing parity (what is equivalent , what must be remediated, what requires business sign-off).
  • Lead escalation on complex failures: permissions anomalies, throttling, content mismatches, orphaned identities, broken sharing links, Teams dependency problems.
  • Produce operational metrics for factory execution: throughput, failure categories, rework rate, top blockers and continuous improvement backlog.
  • Align Shared Data cutovers to Identity/Devices/Teams readiness so user experience is protected.

Who You Are

Must Have:

  • Proven delivery of tenant-to-tenant SharePoint/OneDrive migrations at enterprise scale which must be evidenced.
  • Deep SharePoint Online/OneDrive expertise (permissions, sharing, IA, metadata, site templates, modern site constructs, governance controls).
  • Hands-on experience using ShareGate (preferred) or comparable enterprise migration tooling and ability to interpret logs and failure modes.
  • Strong understanding of Teams-connected content storage patterns and how Teams usage intersects with SharePoint/OneDrive.
  • Experience building factory-ready runbooks, validation gates and evidence packs to drive repeatable execution.
  • Strong troubleshooting mindset: can isolate issues quickly, define a fix pattern and push it into standard practice.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with highly regulated or complex governance environments (strict retention, compliance, sensitivity labelling interactions).
  • Familiarity with scripting and automation for checks/remediation (PowerShell/Graph).
  • Knowledge of common ODSP migration pitfalls: link behaviour, sharing model differences, permissions sprawl, performance constraints, change windows.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Can drive standards adoption across multiple teams and regions without becoming a blocker.
  • Clear communicator of data risk and end-user impact; no false confidence.
  • Bases trust with business content owners through clarity, not jargon.
  • Maintains a high-quality bar and reduces rework through proper readiness control.
  • Coaches the factory SMEs; enables scaled delivery rather than acting as a bottleneck.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

- This role operates within a three shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

title: Senior Technical Consultant - Shift Lead
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) in the Shared Data/ODSP Factory, you will lead on shift technical delivery for tenant to tenant migrations of collaboration content across Microsoft 365, typically SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business and associated Teams/M365 Group content structures. You will run a controlled, metrics driven migration factory, ensuring runbooks are executed consistently, migrations are scheduled and monitored, permissions/metadata fidelity is validated and defects are remediated efficiently. You will be accountable for shift throughput, quality gates, evidence capture and operational reporting while coordinating escalations and ensuring seamless handovers across the 24x7 model.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical execution of SharePoint/OneDrive/ODSP migration waves during your shift, ensuring runbook adherence and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift triage for failures (throttling, permissions mapping issues, blocked files, metadata/versioning exceptions, large list/library constraints, URL/path constraints).
  • Validate readiness: source/target access, migration accounts/consents, pre checks, quota constraints and cutover schedule alignment.
  • Configure, schedule and monitor migration jobs using the approved toolset (native and/or third party), proactively identifying risks before they become wave blockers.
  • Enforce quality gates: sampling/validation outcomes, permission parity checks, metadata fidelity and user experience verification.
  • Maintain operational control of the shift backlog and prioritise tasks based on cutover plans, dependencies and SLA.
  • Produce and manage evidence packs per wave: migration reports, exception logs, remediation records, sign off artefacts and audit trail completeness.
  • Coordinate handovers with clear exceptions, blockers and next actions; ensure continuity of long running migration jobs across shifts.
  • Drive continuous improvement: update runbooks, known error catalogues and operational dashboards; reduce recurring failures and rework.
  • Manage escalations (vendor support, platform support pathways, programme technical leadership) with complete diagnostic context and clear asks.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Delivered at least one production tenant to tenant migration of SharePoint Online and/or OneDrive (ODSP) content as a senior SME/lead.
  • Deep expertise in SharePoint Online/OneDrive architecture concepts relevant to migration: site structures, permissions models, sharing/links, metadata/versioning, information architecture constraints.
  • Hands on experience with migration tooling in this space (e.g., ShareGate and/or Quest ODM or equivalent) and the ability to run migrations at scale.
  • Proven ability to run migration operations in a factory model: scheduling, monitoring, exception handling and quality gates at high volume.
  • Strong understanding of security/compliance impacts in migrated content (sensitivity labels/retention behaviours where applicable; access governance, least privilege).
  • Strong runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable being held to audit standards for every wave.

Good to Have

  • Experience migrating Teams associated content dependencies (files in SharePoint, OneDrive artefacts linked to user data used by collaboration features) and coordinating sequencing.
  • Familiarity with multi geo considerations and URL/domain nuances that can impact migration execution.
  • Microsoft certifications relevant to Microsoft 365 administration (e.g., MS 102) or SharePoint specialism, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience using PowerShell/Graph for reporting, bulk checks, or automation around migration readiness and validation.
  • Knowledge of data governance, information architecture and content lifecycle management in Microsoft 365.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Keeps shift teams focused on plan and standards; prevents uncontrolled variation in execution.
  • Communicates clearly with upstream/downstream disciplines (Identity, Teams, Adoption, Security) to manage dependencies and unblock progress.
  • Escalates early and responsibly with evidence; avoids late surprises .
  • Coaches engineers to solve problems systematically (root cause, pattern recognition, runbook refinement).
  • Strong stakeholder communication habits suitable for a major programme: concise, factual, action oriented updates.
  • Builds trust through calm leadership during cutovers and operational incidents.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: sites/OneDrives migrated per shift; data volume migrated vs plan.
  • Defect rate: percentage of migrations requiring re run; recurring exception types reduced over time.
  • MTTR: resolution time for migration blockers and priority incidents.
  • Evidence capture: percentage of waves with complete exportable reports and sign off records.
  • SLA: scheduled cutovers achieved on time with managed risk and exceptions logged.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

  • This role operates within a three shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

Job Summary

Title: Expert Data Engineer

Shift: 11:00AM - 8:00PM

Work Mode: Hybrid

Location: Bangalore

Introduction to the job:

The AI Data Engineering Lead owns the design, build, governance, and operational readiness of the data pipelines, data products, knowledge assets, and retrieval-ready datasets required to power AI-enabled products.

This role ensures that AI products are not built on fragmented, low-quality, ungoverned, or inaccessible data. The AI Data Engineering Lead works across product, data architecture, AI engineering, platform engineering, security, risk, compliance, MLOps/LLMOps, and operations to ensure that AI products use trusted, permissioned, explainable, and reusable data and knowledge assets.

Some of the things you ll be doing

1. Own AI-ready data engineering

The AI Data Engineering Lead is accountable for engineering data assets that AI products can safely and effectively use.

  • Translate AI product needs into data requirements, data pipelines, data products, and knowledge asset requirements.
  • Build and manage data pipelines that support AI-enabled applications, RAG solutions, agents, analytics, automation, and decision-support capabilities.
  • Ensure data used by AI products is complete, accurate, timely, traceable, and fit for purpose.
  • Create reusable data products that can serve multiple products, business units, and AI use cases.
  • Partner with product owners and AI engineers to define what data is required for prompts, retrieval, grounding, classification, extraction, recommendations, and workflow automation.
  • Ensure AI data assets are engineered for scale, resilience, security, cost efficiency, and production support.

2. Build trusted data products

The role turns raw data into governed, reusable, product-ready data assets.

  • Define and build data products for key domains such as client, entity, product, service, transaction, finance, risk, vendor, employee, jurisdiction, and reference data.
  • Establish clear data product ownership, service levels, quality expectations, refresh frequency, and access rules.
  • Create data pipelines that support both transactional product needs and AI/analytics needs.
  • Define source-of-truth usage and reduce reliance on uncontrolled spreadsheets, local files, and duplicate extracts.
  • Ensure data products are documented, discoverable, versioned, and reusable.
  • Partner with data stewards to resolve quality, definition, and ownership issues.

3. Engineer data for RAG and knowledge-based AI

The AI Data Engineering Lead ensures documents and knowledge assets can be safely used by AI.

  • Prepare policies, procedures, contracts, regulatory content, service playbooks, product documentation, client obligations, and operational knowledge for AI retrieval.
  • Define document ingestion, parsing, chunking, embedding, indexing, refresh, and retirement processes.
  • Partner with AI engineering to design vector stores, semantic search, retrieval ranking, grounding, and citation patterns.
  • Ensure retrieval sources are approved, current, versioned, owned, and access-controlled.
  • Validate that AI products retrieve the right content for the right user in the right context.
  • Prevent AI products from using obsolete, conflicting, unauthorized, or unapproved knowledge sources.

4. Own data quality and trust controls

AI products amplify data quality issues, so this role establishes trust at the data layer.

  • Define data quality rules for critical data elements used by AI products.
  • Monitor completeness, accuracy, uniqueness, validity, consistency, and timeliness.
  • Build automated quality checks into pipelines.
  • Create exception handling, issue management, and remediation workflows.
  • Partner with data owners and product teams to prioritize data quality fixes based on business and AI impact.
  • Ensure AI products can identify when data is missing, stale, conflicting, or unreliable.
  • Provide evidence of data quality for product acceptance, risk review, and operational readiness.

5. Manage metadata, catalog, and lineage

The AI Data Engineering Lead ensures teams know what data exists, what it means, where it came from, and how it is used.

  • Capture metadata for datasets, data products, APIs, pipelines, reports, knowledge assets, vector indexes, and AI retrieval sources.
  • Ensure data and knowledge assets are cataloged and discoverable.
  • Define business and technical metadata needed for AI use.
  • Document lineage from source systems through pipelines, transformations, vector stores, prompts, outputs, and consuming products.
  • Support auditability by making source-to-output traceability visible where required.
  • Partner with data governance teams to ensure definitions, ownership, sensitivity, and usage rules are documented.

6. Embed data access, privacy, and security controls

The role ensures AI data usage respects permissions, sensitivity, and client obligations.

  • Define and implement data access controls in collaboration with data owners and product teams.
  • Establish privacy and security controls aligned with regulatory and client obligations.
  • Monitor and enforce data access policies across data pipelines and AI systems.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

You are the offshore specialist leader for tenant to tenant endpoint migration readiness and escalation support. You guide Scale squads and the Factory through device migration sequencing, Intune re enrolment impacts, Autopilot/join state considerations and remediation patterns. This role is critical to avoiding mass disruption: endpoint readiness issues can block user productivity at wave cutovers, so your job is to standardise solutions, reduce repeat failures and provide rapid escalation leadership during cutover windows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide endpoint readiness guidance and risk assessments for migration waves.
  • Act as escalation authority for complex device migration failures and root cause analysis.
  • Define and maintain runbooks for common remediation scenarios (enrolment failures, compliance issues, profile/application targeting problems).
  • Coordinate dependencies with Identity and Security teams (device trust and access controls).
  • Support cutover events with rapid triage and stabilisation leadership.
  • Maintain known issues and fixes catalogue; reduce recurring defects through standard patterns.
  • Provide validation criteria and evidence standards for endpoint readiness and post migration acceptance.
  • Support the Factory discipline leads by improving troubleshooting playbooks and telemetry standards.
  • Provide reporting inputs on failure categories, remediation throughput and readiness health metrics.
  • Align to one region and adjust working patterns to support regional cutovers.

Who You Are

Must Have

  • Delivered tenant to tenant endpoint migration work in production (Intune/Windows specialism mandatory).
  • Deep Intune operational expertise and troubleshooting competence.
  • Practical understanding of device join state and provisioning concepts relevant to tenant transitions.
  • Proven ability to create runbooks, validation steps and known fix playbooks for repeatable execution.
  • Willingness to align working hours to regional cutovers (early/late calls) and support extended hours when required.
  • Strong documentation discipline and evidence first practices.
  • Ability to coach engineers and improve delivery maturity at pace.

Good to Have

  • Experience with workstation/profile migration tooling (e.g., PowerSyncPro or equivalent) and hands on understanding of real world constraints.
  • Microsoft certification alignment relevant to endpoint management (or equivalent experience).
  • PowerShell scripting for diagnostics, readiness reporting and bulk remediation.
  • Experience with large, globally distributed device estates and remote workforce constraints.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Calm escalation leadership in user impacting cutover events.
  • Clear communicator: logs, evidence and precise guidance rather than guesswork.
  • Strong coaching and collaboration behaviours across shifts and teams.
  • Risk and dependency management mindset; prevents avoidable disruption.
  • High integrity around access/security and change discipline.
  • Strong written communication: tickets, handovers, playbooks.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Lower endpoint migration failure rate and improved first time success.
  • MTTR for endpoint migration blockers during cutovers.
  • Repeat issue reduction via improved runbooks and known fix catalogues.
  • Evidence completion rate for endpoint acceptance checks.
  • Readiness pass rate for endpoint components at wave entry.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

Scale teams operate as a cohesive unit within a follow the sun project delivery model. Each scale team works an 8 hour shift, scheduled across a 24 hour global working day. Structured handovers between scale teams are mandatory and cutover periods may require rota flexibility.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

As the Entra Apps Factory Shift Lead, you will lead on shift technical delivery for tenant to tenant transition of enterprise applications, app registrations and associated identity/access integrations that must be re established in the destination tenant. This discipline is core to successful workload migration because application authentication, authorisation, secrets/certificates and trust relationships must be recreated and validated to keep business services functioning through cutover waves. You will run a 24x7 factory model: managing backlogs, enforcing runbooks, coordinating with security/identity stakeholders and ensuring evidence capture for every app remediated.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead execution of Entra Apps migration/remediation runbooks during your shift, ensuring predictable throughput and quality gates.
  • Own triage for application access failures post tenant transition (SSO misconfig, missing claims, certificate/secret issues, redirect URI mismatch, conditional access blocks).
  • Coordinate recreation and validation of enterprise apps and app registrations in the target tenant, including keys/secrets/certs rotation and permissions re grant patterns where applicable.
  • Manage cross tenant access considerations that support collaboration and transition states (where used), ensuring correct governance and safe configuration.
  • Maintain shift backlog, prioritise by business criticality and cutover schedule and coordinate stakeholder validation where required.
  • Drive evidence capture: configuration proof, test results, sign in validation, rollback notes and completion records suitable for audit/governance.
  • Ensure operational handovers are crisp: open risks, high priority apps, dependencies and next actions clearly documented.
  • Coordinate with Devices/Shared Data/Power Platform/Power BI teams to resolve identity and app dependencies impacting wave execution.
  • Drive continuous improvement of runbooks, templates and test scripts to reduce time per app and minimise repeat defects.
  • Escalate complex vendor application issues with complete diagnostic evidence and clear business impact.

Who You Are

Must Have (or equivalent experience):

  • Delivered production tenant to tenant Entra Apps remediation (enterprise apps/app registrations) in your specialism, including cutover validation.
  • Strong hands on expertise with Microsoft Entra ID application constructs: enterprise applications, app registrations, service principals, permissions consent and token/claim concepts.
  • Strong experience with secrets/certificates lifecycle, rotation planning and secure handling practices.
  • Experience working with conditional access and cross tenant access settings where relevant and understanding how these can block or permit access during transition phases.
  • Proven runbook discipline and evidence capture practice; comfortable operating in audited environments.
  • Ability to lead delivery in a 24x7 three shift model, including formal handovers and accountable shift outcomes.

Good to Have:

  • SC 300 certification (or equivalent) and/or MS 102.
  • Microsoft Graph/PowerShell automation experience to accelerate inventory, recreation templates and validation checks.
  • Experience with SSO standards and patterns (SAML/OIDC/OAuth) and federated integrations with third party SaaS vendors.
  • Experience working with multi tenant organisations/collaboration constructs (B2B settings, controlled cross tenant relationships).
  • Strong security mindset: least privilege, access reviews and configuration drift control.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Structured, evidence driven leadership: avoids guesswork and enforces repeatability.
  • Confident communicator with technical and non technical stakeholders; explains risk/impact clearly.
  • Coaches engineers into consistent execution and strong operational habits (tickets, proof, testing).
  • Calm under pressure during cutovers; leads triage with discipline and prioritisation.
  • Strong dependency management behaviours; proactively removes blockers across disciplines.
  • Treats application owners and business teams professionally; sets expectations and drives timely validation.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: apps remediated/tested per shift vs plan.
  • Defect rate: percentage of apps requiring rework after first validation.
  • MTTR: time to restore access for critical apps during wave cutovers.
  • Evidence capture: completeness of configuration proof and validation artefacts per app.
  • SLA: cutover readiness achieved on time; escalations raised early with sufficient evidence.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

This role operates within a three shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

  • Communicate results clearly in team meetings, written reports, and data presentations.
  • Regular mining of literature and keeping oneself up to date with developments in the field of antibody development.
  • Troubleshoot technical challenges and propose practical solutions to keep projects moving.
Qualifications & Experience

Education

Applicants should hold a degree in a relevant life sciences discipline (protein biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology, biotechnology, or a related field) at one of the following levels:

  • PhD (graduated within the last year)
  • Masters degree with a minimum of 3 years of relevant research experience

Technical Skills & Experience

  • Immunoassay Applications: Demonstrated experience in immunoassay development and application testing, including ELISA, Western Blotting, Flow Cytometry, Immunocytochemistry (ICC), Co-immunoprecipitation (co-IP), and Immunohistochemistry (IHC). Advanced expertise in microscopy, spatial biology platforms, and multiplexed IHC/IF/ISH, with experience developing and analyzing high-content tissue imaging assays for protein expression and cellular phenotyping is highly advantageous.
  • Bioinformatics, Programming & AI literacy: Proficiency in Python, R, bioinformatics/computational biology and statistical tools like Pymol, Chimera, BLAST, Alphafold, ggplot etc. Proficiency in deep learning models and/or knowledge of large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and experience in implementing these tools to biological questions is highly desirable.
  • Molecular Biology: Solid foundation in molecular biology techniques including nucleic acid extraction, PCR, cloning, sequence analysis, and vector design.
  • Cell Culture Techniques: Practical experience in standard mammalian or other specialized cell culture techniques supporting protein expression, antibody production, or related workflows.
  • Antibody Development Platforms: Theoretical or practical exposure to antibody development platforms such as hybridoma, single B-cell, display technologies, or other recombinant approaches is desirable.
  • Automation & High-Throughput Methods: Experience with automated liquid-handling platforms, high-content imaging or other high-throughput methodologies is advantageous.
  • Scientific Communication: Track record of scientific output through peer-reviewed publications, project reports, or thesis work. A strong, independent understanding of standard and emerging trends in the field is highly preferred.
  • Data Analysis & Software proficiency: Proficiency in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and statistical software such as GraphPad Prism, ggplot etc. Experience with website and/or database design using various platforms such as HTML, JavaScript, ShinyR, PowerApps etc.

This role is customer-facing and will be responsible for building AMD's commercial systems channel business in support of our customers commercial PCs, servers, and professional graphics. You will be responsible for driving a team that will be building business development with Distribution, NSP and VAR partners by evangelizing AMD technology, building sales programs, enabling sales teams through training, and managing executive relationships.

The Person: Engineers who are passionate about signals, power delivery, transmission lines, measurements, circuits, and system behavior. We value individuals who combine deep technical expertise with humility, innovation, mentorship, and a relentless desire to elevate both technology and the people around them.

  • Architect robust Signal Integrity and Power Integrity solutions using strong engineering fundamentals and first-principles thinking.

  • Develop practical design guidelines and best practices that enable successful platform execution.
  • Correlate simulations with measurements and continuously improve modeling accuracy and methodology.

Job Summary

You will be the Devices discipline Solution Architect for a large-scale, global Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant consolidation programme, operating in an industrialised migration factory model (24x7 delivery across shifts). Your job is in providing technical leadership for the end-to-end device migration execution, ensuring it is delivered consistently across high volume waves with minimal disruption to end users.

This role is for a genuine migration specialist: someone who has delivered multiple endpoint migrations (not just run Intune). You will set the migration patterns, guardrails, runbooks, validation gates, exception handling and escalation paths for the factory execution teams. You will work closely with regional Scale technical leadership and Governance to ensure devices can be migrated repeatably, safely and at pace.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the target state endpoint architecture for the consolidated tenant (join model, identity/device trust, Intune/Autopilot posture, compliance strategy, app delivery strategy).
  • Define the tenant-to-tenant device migration approach including sequencing of: identity readiness device readiness policy/app alignment cutover stabilisation.
  • Establish factory-ready runbooks and quality gates for every major device migration activity (pre-checks, enrolment, policy assignment, app deployment, validation, rollback).
  • Specify and operationalise use of migration tooling (e.g., PowerSyncPro or equivalent), including configuration patterns, telemetry, dashboards and failure triage.
  • Define device cohort segmentation strategies (VIPs, executives, kiosks, shared devices, remote-only, high-risk apps, high-privilege users) and tailored migration patterns for each.
  • Lead architecture decisions for Autopilot strategy, device provisioning, re-enrolment paths, device compliance re-baselining and post-move support.
  • Define the security/compliance impact model (Conditional Access dependencies, compliance policies, device certificates, Defender integration, privileged access constraints).
  • Create and govern the exception framework (what exceptions are allowed, evidence required, approval process, technical debt management).
  • Act as final escalation point for device migration failures and systemic issues; drive root-cause elimination into improved standards/runbooks.
  • Ensure evidence capture is audit-grade for each wave: readiness evidence, validation packs, known-issue logs, acceptance sign-offs.

Who You Are

Must Have:

  • Proven delivery of tenant-to-tenant endpoint migration at enterprise scale (Intune + Windows), must be demonstrated with outcomes, not theory.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in Microsoft Intune, Windows endpoint management, policy design, configuration profiles, compliance, app deployment and troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID device identity, device registration/join states, device trust and Conditional Access device-based controls.
  • Experience designing and running industrialised migration: runbooks, gates, telemetry-driven execution, shift handovers and repeatable factory patterns.
  • Strong PowerShell/Graph troubleshooting mindset (bulk checks, readiness reporting, remediation scripting).
  • Experience managing complex device estates (multi-region, multiple personas, varied network conditions, legacy constraints, heavy endpoint security tooling).
  • Comfortable operating under pressure during cutover windows; able to lead war rooms and make safe, fast decisions.

Good to Have:

  • Experience with PowerSyncPro specifically (or comparable endpoint migration tooling) including operational constraints and troubleshooting patterns.
  • Knowledge of Defender for Endpoint integration, certificate-based auth scenarios, device-based access restrictions and endpoint DLP considerations.
  • Experience with Windows 11 transition alongside tenant consolidation.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Direction-setter behaviour: can set standards, defend them with evidence and get adoption across teams.
  • Calm under pressure; can lead escalation without drama and keep teams focused on outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder translation: can explain device risk/impact in business language without hand-waving.
  • High quality bar: refuses unsafe shortcuts, insists on evidence and repeatability.
  • Coaches engineers and senior SMEs: builds capability, doesn't hoard knowledge.
  • Operates as one-team across onshore/offshore and across identity/security/app stakeholders.

Shift / Working Pattern

  • This role operates within a three shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Senior Technical Consultant (Shift Lead) within the Devices Factory, you will serve as the on shift technical authority for high volume device migrations between Microsoft 365 tenants for a global multi entity enterprise. You will lead execution across a 24x7 factory model, coordinating repeatable, runbook driven waves of Windows 10/11 device transition, Intune/Endpoint Manager re enrolment patterns and Autopilot/Entra join-state activities. You will be accountable for shift readiness (tooling, access, queues), quality gates, evidence capture and rapid issue resolution so that device migrations are delivered safely, predictably and at programme scale. This is a hands on leadership role: you will still troubleshoot complex device migration failures, but your primary success measure is consistent throughput with low rework and disciplined shift operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical delivery of device migration waves during your shift, ensuring operational control, adherence to runbooks and predictable throughput.
  • Own shift level triage for device migration failures (Autopilot registration, enrolment, compliance, conditional access, certificate/device identity issues) and coordinate rapid remediation.
  • Validate pre req readiness (device inventory, hardware hash readiness, targeting, Autopilot profile assignment, migration scheduling) and enforce go/no go criteria.
  • Oversee execution of tenant transition steps for Autopilot where applicable (collection of hashes, deregistration/deletion sequencing, re registration timing, end user reset/re provision coordination).
  • Manage the shift backlog in the agreed ticketing system; prioritise work items by risk, SLA and cutover schedule.
  • Drive strong evidence capture: logs, screenshots, reports, change records and acceptance artefacts aligned to audit and client governance needs.
  • Coordinate shift handover packs (work completed, exceptions, blockers, next actions, risk list) and ensure continuity across the three shift model.
  • Partner with the Devices Solution Architect / discipline lead to update runbooks, troubleshooting guides and standard operating procedures based on real shift learnings.
  • Engage vendor/tool support channels as required (e.g., Autopilot/Intune escalation paths, migration tooling vendors where used), ensuring timely escalations with complete evidence.
  • Lead post migration validation checks and hypercare support for device cohorts; reduce repeat incidents through root cause removal and runbook improvements.

Must Have (or Equivalent Experience)

  • Delivered at least one production tenant to tenant device migration as a technical lead/SME, specifically covering Windows device transition and endpoint management between tenants.
  • Strong hands on expertise with Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, Windows 10/11 provisioning, device compliance policies, configuration profiles and troubleshooting enrolment failures.
  • Hands on experience with Windows Autopilot (device registration concepts, profile assignment, re provisioning) and practical migration sequencing across tenants.
  • Competence in Microsoft Entra ID device identity/join states (Entra joined / hybrid joined / registered concepts) and how these affect access, compliance and conditional access behaviour.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in a runbook first factory model: strict execution steps, peer checking/quality gates and disciplined closure criteria.
  • Proven experience working shift-based delivery with mandatory handovers, queue management and accountability for shift outcomes in a 24x7 environment.
  • Strong PowerShell and automation capability for device readiness and operational scripting (inventory validation, hash collection, reporting, bulk actions), with safe change practices.
  • Strong documentation discipline: ability to produce and maintain clear SOPs, troubleshooting playbooks and evidence packs per migration wave.

Good to Have

  • Experience using profile preservation / workstation migration tooling (e.g., PowerSyncPro or equivalent) to reduce user disruption and post cutover issues.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft security controls impacting devices (Conditional Access trust settings, compliant/hybrid joined trust, device-based access patterns).
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (examples: MD 102, MS 102, SC 300 or equivalent).
  • Experience supporting global migrations with remote user populations and proactive comms/coordination playbooks.
  • ITIL practice awareness (incident/problem/change flow) or equivalent operational governance background.

Interpersonal & Consulting Skills

  • Leads with calm operational control under pressure; sets the tone for disciplined factory execution and avoids heroics that compromise repeatability.
  • Communicates clearly in shift handovers: concise status, crisp risk articulation, unambiguous next actions.
  • Coaches engineers in-flight (without slowing throughput), raising capability by reinforcing patterns, not ad hoc fixes.
  • Confident challenging readiness gaps ( not ready to migrate ) using evidence and agreed criteria.
  • Builds trust quickly with cross functional teams (Identity, Security, Shared Data, Service Desk/hypercare) to remove blockers.
  • Demonstrates ownership: takes problems to closure, documents learning and drives runbook improvements.
  • Works effectively across cultures and time zones; assumes positive intent and maintains high standards.
  • Treats the client environment with professional discipline: secure handling of access, data and evidence artefacts.

Typical Deliverables / KPIs

  • Throughput: devices migrated per shift / per wave vs plan.
  • Quality: first time success rate and defect/rework rate (failed enrolments, repeat tickets).
  • MTTR: mean time to restore/resolve for migration blocking device issues.
  • Evidence capture completeness: percentage of migrations with full log/audit package attached.
  • SLA adherence: on time completion of scheduled waves and timely escalation of blockers.

Shift / Working Pattern Notes

This role operates within a three shift 24x7 Factory model. The specific rota will be confirmed, but shift handovers are mandatory and performance is measured on shift outcomes. Peak cutover windows may require schedule flexibility.

Job Summary

As a Senior Identity Security Engineer, you will be a key hands-on contributor to Anaplan s identity security function. Working as part of a collaborative security team, you will administer and mature our IGA capability, contribute to the build-out of our Privileged Access Management programme, and help shape the governance of non-human and AI agent identities as part of our broader Zero Trust strategy.

Responsibilities

  • IGA Platform Administration: Be a key contributor to the day-to-day administration and ongoing development of Anaplan s Identity Governance and Administration platform (currently SailPoint). This includes supporting the full identity lifecycle (joiner, mover, leaver), configuring and maintaining application connectors, building and refining role models, and running access certification campaigns to ensure least-privilege access across the organisation.
  • PAM Programme Build-Out: Play a key role in the evaluation, selection, and initial implementation of Anaplan s Privileged Access Management capability. Help define requirements, assess tooling options, and work with cross-functional stakeholders to design and deploy a PAM solution covering privileged account discovery and vaulting, just-in-time (JIT) access, session monitoring, and credential rotation.
  • Non-Human Identity (NHI) Lifecycle Management: Contribute to the development and implementation of governance frameworks for non-human identities across the enterprise, including service accounts, API keys, secrets, certificates, and OAuth tokens. Ensure all NHI are inventoried, governed, and subject to appropriate lifecycle controls, integrating with secrets management solutions where applicable.
  • AI Agent Identity & Security: Be a key technical contributor to identity security for AI agents and automated workflows, ensuring appropriate scoping, lifecycle management, and least-privilege access models are applied. Help develop and enforce policies governing how AI agents authenticate, authorise, and interact with Anaplan s systems and data.
  • Identity Automation & Engineering: Build and maintain automation to streamline identity processes, including provisioning and de-provisioning workflows, access request fulfilment, and lifecycle rule development. Contribute scripts, integrations, and tooling that reduce manual effort and improve accuracy and consistency across identity operations.
  • Access Governance & Compliance: Support access review and certification processes, SoD (Separation of Duties) policy definition and enforcement, and identity-related audit reporting. Contribute to Anaplan s compliance programmes (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001) by ensuring identity controls are well-documented, consistently applied, and evidenced for audit purposes.
  • Identity Architecture & Strategy: Contribute to the evolution of Anaplan s identity security architecture, applying Zero Trust principles and advocating for least-privilege and just-in-time access across cloud and on-premises environments. Engage with engineering and platform teams to embed identity security requirements into new and existing systems.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with HR, IT, Engineering, and Security teams to define and maintain access policies, onboarding and offboarding processes, and role-based access models. Communicate identity risks, control gaps, and remediation plans clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

What you'll bring to the role

We are looking for an experienced identity security practitioner with deep hands-on IGA expertise and a strong foundation across the broader identity and access management discipline. You will bring:

  • IGA Platform Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on experience administering an enterprise IGA platform, with strong preference for SailPoint (IdentityNow or IdentityIQ). Experience should include identity lifecycle management, access certifications, connector configuration, role management, and lifecycle rule development. Familiarity with additional IGA platforms (e.g. Saviynt, Omada, One Identity) is highly desirable, given our intent to maintain platform-agnostic capability.
  • PAM Knowledge & Capability Building: Solid understanding of Privileged Access Management concepts and technologies, including privileged account vaulting, session recording, JIT access, and credential rotation. Prior experience evaluating or implementing a PAM solution is a strong advantage; candidates who have contributed to a PAM programme build from the ground up are particularly sought after.
  • Non-Human Identity Management: Experience governing NHI at scale, including service accounts, API keys, OAuth/OIDC tokens, certificates, and secrets. Familiarity with enterprise secrets management platforms (e.g. HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, CyberArk Conjur) and an understanding of the unique risks associated with unmanaged or over-privileged NHI.
  • AI Agent & Agentic Workflow Identity: Understanding of the identity and access challenges posed by AI agents and automated systems, including how to scope, govern, and lifecycle-manage machine identities operating within or on behalf of AI-driven workflows. Experience in this area is emerging and will be valued highly.
  • Identity Protocols & Standards: Strong working knowledge of core identity protocols and standards including SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, LDAP, and Kerberos, and their practical application in hybrid enterprise environments.
  • Cloud IAM: Hands-on experience with cloud IAM platforms, particularly AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), and/or GCP IAM, including policy design, role management, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM) capabilities.
  • Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages commonly used in identity automation (e.g. Python, PowerShell, Java/BeanShell for SailPoint rule development). Ability to build integrations and workflows that reduce manual identity operations.
  • Security Frameworks & Compliance: Familiarity with identity-relevant security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g. NIST SP 800-63, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2), and an understanding of how IGA and PAM controls map to audit and regulatory requirements.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong ability to translate complex identity security concepts for non-technical stakeholders, and to work cross-functionally across HR, IT, Engineering, and Security to deliver identity outcomes. Clear documentation skills are essential

jobDescription:
Job Summary

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will work closely with global institutional investors, hedge funds, and asset managers, serving as an extension of their investment research teams.

This role offers hands-on exposure to financial modelling, equity research, investment thesis development, valuation, and capital allocation across global markets. It is an excellent opportunity for professionals seeking careers in asset management, private equity, equity research, or portfolio management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Financial Modelling Analysis
    • Build, maintain, and enhance detailed three-statement financial models using InSync's proprietary modelling platform and AI tools.
    • Prepare quarterly earnings models, revenue forecasts, margin analysis, DCF valuations, comparable company analysis, and scenario-based forecasts.
    • Convert complex financial information into accurate, client-ready analytical insights.
  • Investment Research
    • Support portfolio managers and senior investment professionals with research and investment idea generation.
    • Conduct in-depth fundamental research across industries and companies.
    • Analyze competitive positioning, industry trends, market size (TAM), unit economics, and business performance.
    • Monitor earnings calls, company filings, management commentary, sell-side reports, and industry developments.
    • Utilize AI-powered research tools to improve research efficiency and accelerate insight generation.
  • Data Analysis AI-Driven Research
    • Leverage institutional datasets to perform advanced financial analysis.
    • Analyze consensus estimates, ownership trends, estimate revisions, supply chain data, and market signals.
    • Utilize AI-powered research assistants and data platforms to automate data extraction and analysis.
    • Collaborate with product and data engineering teams to improve financial models and data quality.
  • Client Engagement
    • Act as a trusted research partner for institutional investment clients.
    • Deliver timely financial model updates, earnings previews, research reports, and ad hoc analytical projects.
    • Build strong working relationships with client teams while understanding their investment processes and priorities.

Qualifications Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative field.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience in Equity Research, Investment Banking, Financial Consulting, or a similar analytical role. Exceptional fresh graduates may also be considered.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting, financial modelling, and valuation techniques (DCF, Comparable Company Analysis, SOTP).
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; exposure to FactSet or similar financial data platforms is an added advantage.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data.
  • Self-driven, detail-oriented, and passionate about financial markets and investing.
  • CFA Charterholders or candidates pursuing advanced levels of the CFA program will be preferred.

As a Data Scientist on the Global Finance Data Science team, you will develop and maintain data science solutions and supporting data pipelines for J&J s Global Finance organization. Working with a global team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Finance Analysts, and ML Engineers, you will help advance the Global Finance data science and AI roadmap, deliver actionable insights to finance and business leaders, reduce manual effort through automation, and enhance the user experience.

You will operate and enhance Global Finance data science projects in production on a monthly basis, with a focus on Predictive Financial Intelligence and forecasting. You will build automated data pipelines using finance source systems, including SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA, and platforms such as Databricks. You will also help transition proofs of concept into reliable production solutions, incorporate stakeholder feedback, develop performance tracking Power BI dashboards, and integrate conversational analytics into dashboards and applications.

Major Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop and automate data processing and modeling pipelines for large datasets from finance and ERP systems, including SAP HANA and SAP BW.
  • Write scalable, production-grade Python code.
  • Run and maintain data science projects in production on a monthly basis, incorporating enhancements based on evolving business needs and stakeholder feedback.
  • Develop data science solutions by translating business problems into analytical approaches, processing data, identifying trends and patterns, generating insights, and communicating findings.
  • Implement machine learning and statistical models for predictive analytics, time series forecasting, decision support, Generative AI, and natural language processing use cases.
  • Develop Power BI dashboards and production-grade data models that translate analytical outputs into actionable business insights.
  • Deploy analytical models into production and ensure adherence to requirements and standards, including version control and documentation.
  • Help migrate existing Predictive Financial Intelligence projects to the Databricks production environment.
  • Partner with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Finance Analysts, ML Engineers, and stakeholders across Global Finance.
  • Present results and explain complex analyses and data pipelines clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Understand and apply finance master data, Common Information Model (CIM) elements, attributes, mappings, and organizational, geographic, product, and reporting hierarchies in analytical solutions.
  • Work effectively across time zones in an agile environment, balancing priorities and deadlines while fostering collaboration, innovation, and inclusion.
  • Develop a strong understanding of J&J s business, finance terminology, processes, and data landscape.

Technical Requirements

  • Strong experience writing production-grade Python code and applying software engineering best practices, including modular programming, version control, and documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  • Experience using SQL and PySpark to acquire, transform, and analyze data, with knowledge of data warehouses and ERP systems such as SAP S/4HANA.
  • Interest to develop understanding of finance master data and the Common Information Model (CIM), including key data elements, attributes, mappings, and hierarchies used across financial reporting and analytics.
  • Experience developing production-grade data pipelines and data models and taking analytical models from proof of concept to production deployment.
  • Experience with machine learning and statistical techniques, including regression, time series forecasting, clustering, decision trees, and statistical testing.
  • Experience with Power BI for data modeling, visualization, and dashboard development.
  • Experience integrating conversational AI or LLM-based capabilities into dashboards and applications is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Generative AI platforms and governance tools such as AWS Bedrock, Databricks Genie, Unity Catalog, OpenAI, or Claude is preferred.
  • Knowledge of model deployment, API integration, and workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or Kubernetes is preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, prioritization, and continuous improvement skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within a global team and adapt to changing priorities, deadlines, risk, and compliance requirements.

title: AI - Writer
jobDescription:
About the Role: Kuku AI Studio is building the worlds first large - scale AI - native microdrama production house. We make short - form shows for hundreds of millions of viewers who watch on their phones commuting, on breaks, in the minutes between everything else. Every show we produce starts with a story skeleton. The AI Writer is the person who builds that skeleton and fills it with emotional architecture that the rest of the production pipeline can execute. This is not a conventional screenwriting role. You will not write in isolation and hand off a finished script. You will work as part of a production pipeline where your output feeds directly into an AI Director and AI Architect pair who generate the show from your brief. Your writing is the creative specification for a machine. It must be precise enough to be executed, and emotionally true enough to be felt. If you are a writer who loves structure as much as story who finds the architecture of why a scene works as interesting as the scene itself this role was designed for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Read and internalise the adapted story skeleton character wounds, base emotion, identity threats, setting symbolism, arc structure and translate that into episode - level decisions.
  • Develop full episode beat sheets covering every episodes hook, plot advancement, key emotional beat, close type, and the single question the audience is left with.
  • Write episode briefs that are compressed, precise, and immediately executable by an AI Architect without requiring creative interpretation.
  • Produce dialogue that passes two tests simultaneously it must work as audio alone for a viewer who is not watching, and it must carry full subtext for a viewer who is watching but not listening.

Emotional architecture:

  • Place paywalls correctly at peak emotional injustice or identity threat, never at a plot reveal.
  • Design cliffhangers that leave the audience with an emotional question they cannot bear to leave unanswered not a plot question, an emotional one.
  • Calibrate the cliffhanger - to - satisfying - close ratio across a season too many consecutive cliffhangers creates fatigue, not urgency.
  • Write dialogue that differentiates every character by voice alone two characters in this show must never be interchangeable when their lines are read without attribution.

Pipeline and collaboration:

  • Brief the AI Director on the emotional intent of each episode before they begin visual execution your brief is their creative specification.
  • Review AI - generated episode output against your intended emotional architecture and flag structural mismatches to the Creative Producer.
  • Stay ahead of the director pairs in your pod scripts must be ready before the production window opens, not during it.

Contribute to the script pattern library every structural solution you find to a recurring story problem becomes reusable for the whole team.

What We are Looking For :

  • A background in screenwriting, content writing, or creative writing formal training is a plus but a strong portfolio matters more.
  • Genuine understanding of what makes someone stop scrolling you have watched enough microdrama or serialized fiction to know the difference between a hook that works and one that explains itself.
  • The ability to write emotion without stating it your characters should never explain what they feel in dialogue.
  • Speed under pressure you need to be productive at volume without losing quality.
  • Fluency in Hindi and English many of our shows are multilingual and cultural register accuracy is non - negotiable.
  • Curiosity about AI as a creative tool you will be writing for an AI pipeline, which means understanding what an AI can and cannot do with the brief you give it.
